_source: Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne 1.20.x object tables (war3.mpq Units/UnitBalance.slk defType, Units/UnitWeapons.slk atkTypeN) plus the Blizzard Damage Type table.

_conventions.length: tile units; 1 terrain tile = 64 SLK game-units (divide SLK by 64)
_conventions.speed: tiles/s; SLK spd px/s divided by 64

attackTypes.name: Normal
attackTypes.description: Full damage against every unit armour type; halved against Fortified.

attackTypes.name: Pierce
attackTypes.description: +50% vs Light, -25% vs Heavy, poor vs Fortified/Ancient.

attackTypes.name: Magic
attackTypes.description: +50% vs Unarmoured/Light/Normal, -50% vs Heavy, near-immune vs Hero.

attackTypes.name: Chaos
attackTypes.description: Full damage against all armour types including Fortified and Ancient.

attackTypes.name: Hero
attackTypes.description: Full damage vs units, halved vs Fortified structures.

attackTypes.name: Siege
attackTypes.description: Doubled vs Fortified, reduced vs Hero/Ancient and most unit armour via bonus table.

attackTypes.name: Spell
attackTypes.description: Spell damage; mitigated by Magic Resistance and spell immunity.

armorTypes.name: Enhanced
armorTypes.description: Extended armour type; reduces all incoming attacks to 75%.

armorTypes.name: Hero
armorTypes.description: Attenuated by the negative-armour curve; takes only 30% from Magic.

armorTypes.name: Fortified
armorTypes.description: Structures: 50% from Normal/Hero, 35% from Pierce/Magic/Spell, 200% from Siege.

armorTypes.name: Ancient
armorTypes.description: Only Chaos deals full damage; everything else is heavily reduced.

armorCurve.formula: reduction = (ARMOR_CONST * A) / (ARMOR_CONST * A - 1) * -1  i.e. damageTaken = raw * (1 - red)
armorCurve.note: Negative armour increases damage taken on the same curve. This is the WC3 "armor" field (UnitBalance realdef), not an armour TYPE.
armorCurve._note: verify: closed form matches in-game results for |A| <= ~20; harness clamps outside that band.

magicResistance._note: verify: base MR is 0 for all races except spells that specify otherwise; Intelligence grants 0.1% per point above the hero's primary-attribute contribution.

splash.model: three concentric bands: full inside fullArea, half between fullArea..halfArea (halfFactor), quarter between halfArea..quarterArea (quarterFactor). Damage beyond the target is applied to splashTargs extra units and scaled by damageLoss.

attackBounce._note: verify: bounce chain stored in buff/aura data rather than UnitWeapons columns.

piercing.note: Units with minRange > 0 will not fire at targets closer than that radius (mortar team, flying machine siege mode).

attackSpeed._note: verify: MiscData AgiAttackSpeedBonus = 0.01 per agility point.

damageBonuses.note: Per-attack-type flat bonuses live in the unit weapon dmgplus/upg fields, not a global table.
